decision.summary: Two temporally adjacent multi-axis events are observed: (1) a sharp onset offset starting at index 557 with sustained platform until 607, lacking a full return within the window—hence uncertain; (2) a coherent reversal from 608 to 612 that restores all three components toward prior levels, confirmed as a temporary offset interval. The reversal aligns with the optional jump at 608 and shows clear opposing motion on all axes.

intervals.observation: Sharp multi-axis drop in N/E/U beginning ~557 (N: -5.3→-6.2, E: 19.0→18.1, U: 21.5→24.5 MAD), sustained platform through ~607 with coherent offset (N ~ -5 to -7, E ~16–19, U ~20–24). No opposing return observed within allowed context; partial N recovery starts at 608 but not full reversal.

Abrupt multi-sample reversal near 608–612: N jumps +7.5 (−6.1→−0.2), E −15.8 (17.9→1.4), U −19.6 (22.9→3.3), restoring components toward pre-offset levels. Return is coherent across axes and completes by index 612, though U remains slightly elevated (~3.8 vs prior ~2.8).
